edition.title: Split-Zero cohomology: original periods, conductor transfer and mixed-state volumes
edition.scope: This edition develops the original mixed cohomology of the Split-Zero research programme through explicit period, conductor and Gamma-polynomial calculations. It proves a conductor vanishing-order domain for every fixed nonzero original amplitude, including the two exceptional limiting phases; an exact transfer between the two original connecting endpoints; and a finite bound for the corrected first Gamma row. A full conductor-dual construction transports the original restrictions and quotient metrics to numerator observations with controlled volume error. An exact kernel formula then expresses the complete eight-matrix mixed profile and all complementary returns in those original coordinates.
edition.verification_scope: The accepted 765-page cumulative paper and 103-page supplement retain the source owner's recorded mathematical and visual reviews. This publication reuses that acceptance and verifies exact archive lineage, preserved source bytes and public downloads. It claims no new Lean execution, independent human peer review, or Riemann-hypothesis resolution. The complete publication ZIP was assembled locally from the accepted source cut; it is not a producer-supplied complete archive. Subsequent unsealed calculations are excluded. The accompanying exposition and mapping-torus and multiplier/module source clarifications retain their stated verification scopes and source-access gaps.
